topic: How to Wash Wool Without Felting It
notes: The garment care label controls. Explain that machine-washable wool can use a wool/gentle cycle when the label permits it, while hand-wash-only or do-not-wash items need different care. Use mild wool-compatible detergent guidance and avoid agitation, wringing and unsupported heat advice. Prefer flat drying for knitwear when consistent with the label.
